name: stage7_dense_week_v0
description: Stage 7 fixture v0 — dense recall portion only. The README's v1.0 acceptance test is '10-turn real-week → 24h+ → 3 questions'. This fixture exercises the 10 conversational turns plus the 3 question turns, testing whether facts stated early survive distractor turns and whether two distinct people are not conflated. The 24h time-gap portion of Stage 7 is NOT exercised here because Luna currently has no automatic time-decay process: forgotten_risk is a field but no runtime path drives it from elapsed time, so a 0-second gap and a 24h gap behave identically today. When time-decay lands, this fixture should be re-run with explicit gap semantics. Until then, this is the dense-recall half of Stage 7.
